title: Failure Prediction at Runtime for Generative Robot Policies
abstract: FIPER predicts runtime failure in generative imitation-learning policies using observation out-of-distribution scores and action-chunk entropy calibrated on successful rollouts.

title: Perturbation-Based Epistemic Uncertainty for Failure Detection in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: A training-free framework injects low-rank weight perturbations into VLA models and uses action disagreement as epistemic uncertainty for failure detection under distribution shift.

title: SAFE: Multitask Failure Detection for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: SAFE learns a task-general failure score from VLA internal features, evaluates unseen tasks and environments, and calibrates time-varying alert thresholds with conformal prediction.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: Velocity-field disagreement across a small ensemble quantifies epistemic uncertainty in flow-based VLAs for failure detection and active multitask fine-tuning.

title: Ask Before You Act: Token-Level Uncertainty for Intervention in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: Token-level entropy and perplexity from a fine-tuned pi0-FAST policy trigger human intervention and shared control during robotic manipulation.
